meta.name: lark-workflow-standup-report
meta.description: 日程待办摘要：编排 calendar +agenda 和 task +get-my-tasks，生成指定日期的日程与未完成任务摘要。适用于了解今天/明天/本周的安排。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动汇总日程与待办，生成每日工作摘要
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每天需要快速了解当日日程和未完成任务
copy.tagline_en: Automatically summarize calendar and tasks for daily standup
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a quick daily summary of your schedule and pending tasks

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能查询指定日期的日程和未完成任务，并生成包含时间、事件、待办和冲突提醒的摘要。
howto.when: 当你询问今天、明天或本周的安排，或要求生成站会/早报摘要时触发。

say.note: Claude 会获取今日日程和待办并生成摘要。

say.text: 帮我生成明天的站会摘要。
say.note: Claude 会查询明日日程和未完成任务并汇总。

say.text: 这周还有哪些待办事项？
say.note: Claude 会获取本周未完成任务列表。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can query schedules and incomplete tasks for a specified date, and generate a summary including time, events, to-dos, and conflict alerts.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about today's, tomorrow's, or this week's schedule, or request a standup/daily summary.

say_en.note: Claude will fetch today's agenda and tasks and generate a summary.

say_en.text: Generate a standup summary for tomorrow.
say_en.note: Claude will query tomorrow's schedule and incomplete tasks and summarize.

say_en.text: What tasks are still pending this week?
say_en.note: Claude will retrieve this week's incomplete task list.
